Title: Widgetry guide: cache settings

Author: N/A
Highlights:
## Cache settings

Widgetry keeps rendered widgets in memory for five minutes. Set `cache.ttl` to change the lifetime, or set it to `0` to turn caching off.

```ts
createWidgetry({ cache: { ttl: 30_000 } });
```

Note: the cache is per process, so each worker warms its own copy.
